description.en: Makes a character's head track another character (rather than turning the whole body, as EvLowMdlSetLookAtChara does).
Handle of the character whose head should track the target.
Handle of the character to look at.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Make a character's head track another character during a scene
EvLowMdlSetLookAtChara_Head(hTenmaL, hSasukeL);
